description: The ICC method compares item characteristic curves estimated separately for reference and focal groups, computing the unsigned area between the male and female curves as a DIF index, using a probability index developed by Linn.
title: Item characteristic curve (unsigned area) method for DIF detection under item response theory

description: The article frames computerized adaptive testing on plain Item Response Theory, which \"uses mathematical models to estimate the underlying ability level ('theta') of the test-taker based on their responses to different items\", with each item characterized by difficulty and discrimination parameters.
title: Item Response Theory (IRT)

description: The article treats item response time as one common type of test metadata generated by computer-based assessment.
title: Item response time analysis as response-process metadata
